import sys
import math

MOD = 1000000007

def modpow(a, e):
    ret = 1
    while e > 0:
        if e & 1:
            ret = (ret * a) % MOD
        a = (a * a) % MOD
        e >>= 1
    return ret

# Read input
n = int(sys.stdin.readline())

pr = [[0]*6 for _ in range(6)]
for i in range(n):
    row = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    for j in range(n):
        pr[i][j] = (row[j] * modpow(100, MOD - 2)) % MOD
for i in range(n, 6):
    for j in range(6):
        pr[i][j] = 1

# Generate m3 and comp
m3 = []
map_dict = {}
for i in range(1 << 6):
    if bin(i).count('1') == 3:
        m3.append(i)
        map_dict[i] = len(m3) - 1

comp = [0] * 20
for i in range(20):
    comp[i] = 0

for i in range(1 << 6):
    if bin(i).count('1') == 3:
        comp[map_dict[i]] = map_dict[i ^ 63]

assert len(map_dict) == 20

sub = [[1] * (1 << 18) for _ in range(2)]
mas = [0] * (1 << 18)

for mask in range(1 << 18):
    sub[0][mask] = 1
    sub[1][mask] = 1
    for i in range(6):
        for j in range(3):
            if mask & (1 << (i * 3 + j)):
                sub[0][mask] = (sub[0][mask] * pr[i][j]) % MOD
                sub[1][mask] = (sub[1][mask] * pr[i][3 + j]) % MOD
            else:
                od = 1 - pr[i][j]
                if od < 0:
                    od += MOD
                sub[0][mask] = (sub[0][mask] * od) % MOD
                od = 1 - pr[i][3 + j]
                if od < 0:
                    od += MOD
                sub[1][mask] = (sub[1][mask] * od) % MOD

    ind = 0
    for m in m3:
        guys = []
        for i in range(6):
            if m & (1 << i):
                guys.append(i)
        bad = False
        for xd in range(1 << 3):
            ms = 0
            for i in range(3):
                if xd & (1 << i):
                    ms |= (mask >> (guys[i] * 3)) & 7
            if bin(xd).count('1') > bin(ms).count('1'):
                bad = True
                break
        if not bad:
            mas[mask] += (1 << ind)
        ind += 1

p = [[0] * (1 << 20) for _ in range(2)]
for i in range(1 << 18):
    p[0][mas[i]] = (p[0][mas[i]] + sub[0][i]) % MOD
    p[1][comp[mas[i]]] = (p[1][comp[mas[i]]] + sub[1][i]) % MOD

for i in range(20):
    for mask in range(1 << 20):
        if mask & (1 << i):
            p[1][mask] = (p[1][mask] + p[1][mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD

ans = 0
for i in range(1 << 20):
    ans = (ans + p[0][i] * p[1][i ^ ((1 << 20) - 1)]) % MOD

ans = (1 - ans) % MOD
print(ans)
